mapper.select: select last(session_complete,time) as 会话完成数, last(queue_abort,time) as 排队放弃数, last(queue_duration,time) as 平均排队时长, last(session_duration,time) as 平均会话时长 from session_event_new where enterprise_id = 8001678 and qno in ('QNO1','QNO2','QNO3','QNO4','QNO5','QNO6','QNO7','QNO8','QNO9','QNO10');

select count(1), avg(duration) from (select session_unique_id, last(duration_since_last_state, time) as duration from reception_records where reception_value in ('队列号C', '队列号B') and reception_status = '结束会话' and time > CURRENT_DATE group by session_unique_id) as rrsui;
